read.thesis: Cognizant trimmed FY26 cc revenue growth to 4.0–4.4% from 4–5.5% on Healthcare and consumer softness and furloughs, while margin guide held at ~16.1%; supply-side signals are mixed with no capacity or capex discipline data.

triggers.label: FY26 revenue guide cut to 4.0–4.4%
triggers.quote: Our full year guidance is now 4% to 4.4% growth in constant currency compared to 4% to 5.5% previously.

triggers.label: DSO up 5 days to 89
triggers.quote: DSO was 89 days, up 5 days year-over-year, primarily driven by a change in business mix.

triggers.label: Q4 revenue growth 3.2–4.7%
triggers.quote: For the fourth quarter, we expect revenue to grow 3.2% to 4.7% year-over-year in constant currency.

triggers.label: Trailing 12M bookings +4%, book-to-bill 1.3
triggers.quote: On a trailing 12-month basis, bookings grew 4% and represented a book-to-bill of 1.3x.

guidance.quote: Our full year guidance is now 4% to 4.4% growth in constant currency compared to 4% to 5.5% previously.
For the fourth quarter, we expect revenue to grow 3.2% to 4.7% year-over-year in constant currency.
We are narrowing our adjusted operating margin guidance to approximately 16.1%, which is midpoint of our prior range
We are narrowing our full year EPS guidance range to $5.72 to $5.79, representing 8% to 10% growth.
We now expect total cost of $180 million to $250 million, down from our previous estimate of $230 million to $320 million.
We continue to expect free cash flow conversion to be 90% to 100% of net income for the full year.
Our full year tax rate guidance is around 25% compared to prior range of 25% to 26%.
Our full year weighted average diluted share count guidance of approximately 460 million is unchanged.

prior_guidance_check.quote: Our full year guidance is now 4% to 4.4% growth in constant currency compared to 4% to 5.5% previously.
We are narrowing our adjusted operating margin guidance to approximately 16.1%, which is midpoint of our prior range
We now expect to generate in-year savings of around $200 million in 2026, consistent with the lower end of our prior range.
We continue to expect free cash flow conversion to be 90% to 100% of net income for the full year.

red_flags.label: Revenue guide cut; Healthcare and consumer discretionary weakness
red_flags.quote: these macro factors have led to additional pressure on discretionary spending

red_flags.label: DSO up 5 days to 89 days
red_flags.quote: DSO was 89 days, up 5 days year-over-year, primarily driven by a change in business mix.

red_flags.label: Furlough impact higher in Q4
red_flags.quote: higher impact from furloughs in the fourth quarter than previously expected

evasions.quote: it is a little early for us to comment for 2027.
